Ashley: Quick RFC follow-up — propose we split quant-profile responsibilities into three orthogonal layers: declaration (model-level hints), per-layer overrides, and runtime-adapter view. This keeps profiles composable and reduces migration pain. Thoughts? :thinking:
Ben: +1 to orthogonality. Concern: runtime negotiation needs a lightweight signature so we don't handshake full profiles per request.
Katie: Agree. Suggest a compact signature hash + version and optional "capabilities" bitfield. Example: `profile_sig=v1:sha256(...)|caps=fp8,int8,kv-cache`.
Raj: How do we handle backwards compat when we swap adapter impls? we have customers pinning profiles.
Ashley: Plan: store profile manifest separate from adapter code. Manifest includes `compat_level` and `fallback_chain` array. Runtime picks highest compatible variant.
Morgan: Can we add a migration lint that flags non-orthogonal fields? e.g., runtime-only flags inside declaration.
Ben: +1. Also telemetry: we need delimiters for which layer caused quality change. Propose emit tags: `profile.layer=declaration|override|adapter` and `profile.delta_reason=quantization|rounding|kernel`.
Ashley: Example manifest snippet:
```json
{"id":"p-abc123","sig":"v1:...","layers":{"decl":{"preferred":"fp8"},"layer_overrides":{"attn":"int8"},"adapter":{"max_batch":8}},"compat_level":2,"fallback":["fp8->int8","int8->int4"]}
```
Katie: We should avoid embedding kernel knobs into manifest; adapter should expose capabilities instead.
Raj: Ops ask: how do we roll out new `compat_level`? staged canary + `profile:shadow` sampling.
Ashley: Action items: (1) finalise manifest schema (2) add signature API (3) telemetry tags & sampling plan (4) ops playbook for compat_level rollouts.
Morgan: I'll draft manifest PR. ETA Thu.
ops-bot: Deploy window reminder: canary cluster scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Ben: Awesome, thanks. Quick Q: can runtime fallbacks be synchronous or async? prefer sync for latency-critical endpoints.
Ashley: Default sync, but adapter can advertise `async_fallback: true` in capabilities.
Katie: noted. I'm adding a lint rule to CI.
Morgan: will include tests for telemetry tags.
Ashley: cool — let's reconvene after PRs land. :thumbsup:
